exposure: Baseline Infant and Young child feeding (IYCF) practices
outcome: Infant and Young child feeding (IYCF) practices (breastfeeding initiation, colostrum receipt, prelacteal feed, exclusive breastfeeding, complementary feeding initiation and quality)
cohort: The study included mothers and their infants aged 6 months to 2 years attending an immunization clinic in a tertiary care hospital in Western Uttar Pradesh.
finding: Nutritional counselling significantly improved Infant and Young Child Feeding (IYCF) practices and reduced the prevalence of moderate and severe undernutrition in children.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was strongly associated with successful first breastfeeding.
